applications.source: Voight final chapter7, Main Theorem7.7.1 and Proposition7.7.8(b), printed108–111; https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/978-3-030-56694-4_7
applications.available_assertion: Embeddings of a simple algebra into a central simple algebra are conjugate by an invertible element; centralizer dimensions multiply to that of the codomain.
applications.needed_assertion: All labelled F embeddings into B form one rational conjugacy orbit with pointwise stabilizer F*.
applications.constructed_objects: F/Q quadratic field; B/Q central quaternion algebra; dim_Q F=2 and dim_Q B=4. At q the same objects are F_q/Q_q and B_q.
applications.domain_and_exceptions: Characteristic zero, finite-dimensional central quaternion algebra; exact specializations below. No nonmaximal CM orders or conductor changes.
applications.connecting_derivation: Apply the theorem to the two unital embeddings. The centralizer contains F and has dimension4/2=2, hence equals F. The same specialization aligns the unramified subfield in the cyclic local model.
applications.maps_and_conventions: Labelled embeddings; pointwise centralizer, not normalizer; w=v_q(nrd)/2.
applications.retained_limits: No appeal to corrected Corollary7.7.11; no normalizer quotient, quantitative conjugator bound or integral conjugacy assertion.
applications.decision: accepted for the stated application by this non-author reviewer

applications.available_assertion: The local division quaternion algebra has its unique valuation order and an unramified-quadratic cyclic presentation, with residue degree2 and a uniformizer of w-value1/2.
applications.needed_assertion: Exactly two O_q embedding orbits under order units, separated by residue embedding; fixing one gives one F_q* orbit.
applications.constructed_objects: q odd and inert unramified in F; B_q division; O_q the maximal unramified quadratic order.
applications.domain_and_exceptions: Characteristic zero, finite-dimensional central quaternion algebra; exact specializations below. No nonmaximal CM orders or conductor changes.
applications.connecting_derivation: Align the cyclic-model subfield by Skolem–Noether. Uniqueness preserves the valuation order. Write conjugators as a unit times a uniformizer power. Even powers belong to the embedded field up to a unit. The odd class induces the nontrivial residue automorphism; units induce identity on a commutative residue field.
applications.maps_and_conventions: Labelled embeddings; pointwise centralizer, not normalizer; w=v_q(nrd)/2.
applications.retained_limits: Does not prove the Schwartz sign, norm character, or Frobenius action on geometry; those are separately identified inputs. The normalization typo in the source proof does not change its nonnegative-valuation criterion.
applications.decision: accepted for the stated application by this non-author reviewer

applications.source: Voight final chapter14, Main Theorem14.6.1 and Proposition14.6.7(v) implies (iii), section14.6 (publisher HTML theorem anchors; no printed-page claim); https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/978-3-030-56694-4_14
applications.available_assertion: Finite even noncomplex ramification sets classify quaternion algebras; a separable quadratic field embeds exactly when it is a field at all ramified places.
applications.needed_assertion: The chosen B exists and the actual imaginary F embeds into it.
applications.constructed_objects: Global base Q; ramification set{q,infinity}; F imaginary and q inert.
applications.domain_and_exceptions: Characteristic zero, finite-dimensional central quaternion algebra; exact specializations below. No nonmaximal CM orders or conductor changes.
applications.connecting_derivation: The set has two noncomplex places. F tensor R=C and F tensor Q_q is a quadratic field. Apply the two published statements with these exact objects.
applications.maps_and_conventions: Labelled embeddings; pointwise centralizer, not normalizer; w=v_q(nrd)/2.
applications.retained_limits: Published theorem import, not reproof of global reciprocity or all transitive foundations. It is not an integral embedding statement.
applications.decision: accepted for the stated application by this non-author reviewer
